rows.title_full: AN ACT RE-DEFINING THE FELONY OF PROSTITUTION, PROVIDING STIFFER PENALTIES FOR LAW ENFORCERS WHO ACT AS CO-PRINCIPALS FOR PROSTITUTES AND PENALIZING ANY PERSON WHO HIRES THE SERVICES OF ONE, THEREBY AMENDING ARTICLE TWO HUNDRED AND TWO OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE FOR THE PURPOSE
rows.abstract: States that ---    ANY LAW ENFORCER, POLICE OR MILITARY OFFICER  WHO FACILITATES THE FELONY  OF PROSTITUTION EITHER AS A CO-PRINCIPAL BY DIRECT PARTICIPATION, INDUCEMENT  OR INDISPENSABLE COOPERATION SHALL  SUFFER THE  PENALTY OF TWO YEARS IMPRISONMENT AND  A  FINE OF TWENTY THOUSAND PESOS (P20,000.00) AND SHALL NOT BE  ELIGIBLE FOR PROBATION. ANY  OTHER PERSON WHO USES OR  HIRES THE  SERVICES OF  A PROSTITUTE SHALL SUFFER THE PENALTY OR ARRESTO MAYOR AND A  FINE NOT EXCEEDING TWENTY THOUSAND PESOS (P20,000.00). * * *
